about: one documentation page (data pinning) is fetched, cleaned and stored as one chunk

responses.body:
Docs

Data pinning#

You can pin data during workflow development. Data pinning means saving the output data of a node, and using the saved data instead of fetching fresh data in future workflow executions.

Pin data

To pin data in a node: run the node to load data, then in the OUTPUT view select Pin data.

Data pinning is only available for manual executions; production executions ignore pinned data.

Copyright n8n

reads.note: GET https://docs.n8n.io/<link> for the item the caller passed (passthrough sub-workflow trigger)

Gemini embeddings (default model gemini-embedding-001): LangChain embedDocuments is POST /v1beta/models/gemini-embedding-001:batchEmbedContents with one request per chunk; the page text is under the splitter's 1,500 characters, so one chunk and 1 embedding(s). Vectors are synthetic and 16-dimensional (the in-memory store does not check the length)

branches: no IF/Switch; Remove Duplicate Documentation Content passes the page (no history)
expect.offline: The workflow calls itself: Loop Over Documentation Pages hands each batch of links to Ingest Web Page (passthrough), and this fixture starts there with one link, as the analyzer's sub-workflow wake-up does. The in-memory vector store starts empty every run (README, P55/P63: n8n is restarted after a run with process state) and nothing reads it back on this path; the insert and the dedupe history are in-process or in n8n's own database, not outside services. Remove Duplicate Documentation Content keeps its history in n8n's database across executions of the same workflow; a run that repeats a page on the same imported workflow would drop it. Start Indexing and RAG Chatbot are disabled in the template
